elements.char: ical effects such as spin relaxation, eddy currents and field distortions are not at present explicitly
elements.label: text

elements.char: accounted for in our retrospective undersampling approaches or our baseline models. The manifes-
elements.label: text

elements.char: tation of these effects depends upon the object being imaged, the MRI scanner used, and even the
elements.label: text

elements.char: sampling pattern selected. Extending the results from methods developed for this challenge to the
elements.label: text

elements.char: clinic remains an open problem, but we believe the provision of this dataset is an important first
elements.label: text

elements.char: step on the path to this goal.
elements.label: text

elements.char: Conclusion
elements.label: formula

elements.char: In this work we detailed the fastMRI dataset: the largest raw MRI dataset to be made publicly
elements.label: text

elements.char: available to date. Previous public datasets have focused on post-processed magnitude images for
elements.label: text

elements.char: specific biologic and pathologic questions.
elements.label: text

elements.char: Although our dataset was originally acquired for a
elements.label: text

elements.char: focused task, the inclusion of raw k-space data allows methods to be developed for the imaging
elements.label: text

elements.char: pipeline itself, in principle allowing them to be applied on any MRI scanner for any imaging task.
elements.label: text

elements.char: In addition to the data, we provide evaluation metrics and baseline algorithms to aid the research
elements.label: text

elements.char: community in assessing new approaches. Consistent evaluation of MRI reconstruction techniques
elements.label: text

elements.char: is provided by a leaderboard using held-out test data.
elements.label: text

elements.char: We hope that the availability of this dataset will accelerate research in MR image reconstruction,
elements.label: text

elements.char: and will serve as a benchmark during training and validation of new algorithms.
